biggest_catch: Both gift cards are issued only after the referred friend pays their first two CleanSky bills — and the friend must enroll via your personalized referral link at enrollment time (no retroactive credit).
catches: Referred friend must be a new CleanSky customer enrolling in a plan with a 12-month term or longer using your unique referral link at enrollment; referral cannot be applied retroactively.
Both you and your friend receive the $50 gift cards only after the referred customer reaches active/flowing status, remains in good standing, and pays the first two bills.
Referrer's account must be in good standing (no penalties or delinquent payments).
Rewards are $50 Amazon.com or MasterCard gift cards sent via email — not cash, non-transferable; terms subject to change at any time.
A W-9 is required if issued gift card amounts reach $600 in a calendar year.
Program currently available only in select deregulated areas (CleanSky service areas: TX, IL, NJ, OH, PA, MD, DE, MA, NH, DC).
Framing: gift cards offset planned spending; you must already be (or become) a CleanSky customer to earn referrer-side rewards.
